brief:
Israel's parliament convened under a new speaker from the anti-Netanyahu bloc on Wednesday, Al-Monitor reported. The shift marks the beginning of a legislative offensive by opponents of the caretaker prime minister to dismantle policies from his tenure.

The move signals intensified parliamentary activity aimed at reversing Netanyahu's most contentious decisions and initiatives, though specifics of the planned legislation were not detailed.
dek: Israel's parliament met under a new speaker from the anti-Benjamin Netanyahu bloc on Wednesday, as opponents of the caretaker prime minister began a legislative offensive to roll back his divisive legacy.
title: Israel parliament launches legislative push against Netanyahu under new speaker
